fusions.name: Lancing Horn
fusions.desc: A goring thrust that deals 18 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Soured Bellow
fusions.desc: Bellows a bitter breath 3.5 tiles ahead of you that deals 11 poison damage to everything in it, knocks them back 2 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Chew It Over
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. Its effect increases by 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Four-Chambered Gut
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your poison resistance rises by 12%.
